entries.en: The dining room was impeccably clean when the first guests arrived.
entries.zh: 第一批客人到达时，餐厅干净得无可挑剔。

entries.en: The narrator treats the village's traditions as immutable laws of nature.
entries.zh: 叙述者把村庄的传统当作不可改变的自然法则。

entries.en: At her sister's instigation, she finally entered the local photography contest.
entries.zh: 在姐姐的鼓动下，她终于参加了当地的摄影比赛。

entries.en: The balloons rose slowly into a clear, cloudless morning sky.
entries.zh: 气球缓缓升入晴朗无云的晨空。

entries.en: The rescue team received a commendation for its work during the flood.
entries.zh: 救援队因在洪灾中的工作获得了嘉奖。

entries.en: The portrait shows the monarch wearing full ceremonial regalia.
entries.zh: 画像中的君主身着全套礼仪王服，佩戴着王位标识。

entries.en: The mechanic replaced the clogged breather before closing the engine cover.
entries.zh: 机械师更换了堵塞的通气器，然后合上了发动机罩。

entries.en: The old railway station fell into disuse after the line closed.
entries.zh: 线路关闭后，那座旧火车站就废弃不用了。

entries.en: The diagram shows how the three buildings are spatially related.
entries.zh: 这幅图展示了三座建筑在空间上的相互关系。

entries.en: She arrived with windblown hair and sand caught in her jacket.
entries.zh: 她来时头发被风吹乱，夹克里还夹着沙子。

entries.en: He laughed cynically when the mayor promised another round of reforms.
entries.zh: 市长承诺再推行一轮改革时，他冷嘲地笑了。

entries.en: The chair includes a padded support for the lumbar region.
entries.zh: 这把椅子带有一个支撑腰部的软垫。

entries.en: Water damage left most of the documents in the basement unusable.
entries.zh: 水损使地下室里的大部分文件无法使用。

entries.en: The rain continued unabated throughout the night and into the morning.
entries.zh: 雨势整夜没有减弱，一直持续到早晨。

entries.en: He offered brotherly support when his younger cousin moved to the city.
entries.zh: 小表弟搬到城里时，他给予了兄弟般的支持。

entries.en: She left her muddy boots outside and slipped into soft moccasins.
entries.zh: 她把沾泥的靴子留在外面，换上柔软的软皮便鞋。

entries.en: The label came unstuck after the bottle stood in warm water.
entries.zh: 瓶子放在温水里之后，标签就脱落了。

entries.en: The lecture described the implantation of a tiny device beneath the skin.
entries.zh: 讲座介绍了将一个微型装置植入皮下的过程。

entries.en: The novel contrasts the brothers' attitudes toward marriage and promiscuity.
entries.zh: 这部小说对比了兄弟俩对婚姻和性关系放纵的态度。

entries.en: An uninvited guest appeared just as we were serving dessert.
entries.zh: 我们正要上甜点时，一位不速之客出现了。

entries.en: The proposal was roundly criticized for ignoring the needs of local residents.
entries.zh: 这项提案因忽视当地居民的需求而受到严厉批评。

entries.en: He rinsed the paintbrush before mixing a lighter shade of blue.
entries.zh: 他先洗净画笔，再调出更浅的蓝色。

entries.en: The lemonade tasted refreshingly sharp after our long walk in the heat.
entries.zh: 炎热中长途步行之后，这杯柠檬水喝起来酸爽宜人。

entries.en: The cookies had crisp edges and a pleasantly chewy center.
entries.zh: 这些饼干边缘酥脆，中心耐嚼，口感很好。

entries.en: The exhibit examines how colonizers changed the island's language and institutions.
entries.zh: 这场展览探讨殖民者如何改变了该岛的语言和制度。

entries.en: The hens cackled loudly when the farmer opened the coop.
entries.zh: 农夫打开鸡舍时，母鸡们大声咯咯叫了起来。

entries.en: The camera has an inbuilt flash for use in dim rooms.
entries.zh: 这台相机带有内置闪光灯，可在昏暗的房间使用。

entries.en: The critic traced the influence of naturalism on the playwright's early dramas.
entries.zh: 这位评论家追溯了自然主义对该剧作家早期戏剧的影响。

entries.en: Crossing the flooded river in darkness seemed foolhardy to everyone watching.
entries.zh: 在黑暗中渡过涨水的河流，在所有旁观者看来都是有勇无谋的。

entries.en: A laminated map on the wall showed all the local walking trails.
entries.zh: 墙上一张覆膜地图标出了当地所有步行路线。

entries.en: The museum displayed a slender stiletto beside several decorated sword hilts.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一把细长短剑陈列在几只装饰华丽的剑柄旁。

entries.en: The plant's thick, leathery leaves stayed green through the dry season.
entries.zh: 这种植物厚实坚韧如皮革的叶子在旱季依然保持绿色。

entries.en: The anesthesiologist introduced herself before explaining her role during the operation.
entries.zh: 麻醉科医生先作了自我介绍，再解释自己在手术中的职责。

entries.en: The factory's production target became unattainable after a week without power.
entries.zh: 停电一周后，工厂的生产目标已无法实现。

entries.en: Unsurprisingly, the only cafe near the station was busy all morning.
entries.zh: 不出所料，车站附近唯一的咖啡馆整个上午都很忙。

entries.en: The article repeated an unsupported claim about the origins of the painting.
entries.zh: 这篇文章重复了一个关于画作来历的未经证实的说法。

entries.en: An undersea cable carries data between the island and the mainland.
entries.zh: 一条海底电缆在该岛与大陆之间传输数据。

entries.en: A brief altercation over the parking space delayed our departure.
entries.zh: 围绕停车位的一场短暂争吵耽误了我们出发。

entries.en: Her diary often mentions the rheumatism that made winter journeys difficult.
entries.zh: 她的日记常提到风湿病使冬季出行变得困难。

entries.en: The shaded courtyard offered a restful place to sit after the tour.
entries.zh: 游览结束后，阴凉的庭院提供了一个宁静舒适的歇脚处。

entries.en: The gardeners stored their tools in a small outbuilding behind the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 园丁们把工具存放在温室后的一座小附属建筑里。

entries.en: The narrowness of the staircase made moving the wardrobe upstairs difficult.
entries.zh: 楼梯狭窄，把衣柜搬上楼很困难。

entries.en: The harsh wind battered the little tent mercilessly throughout the night.
entries.zh: 猛烈的风整夜无情地拍打着那顶小帐篷。

entries.en: She arranged three shapely ceramic vases along the narrow wooden shelf.
entries.zh: 她把三个造型优美的陶瓷花瓶摆在狭窄的木架上。

entries.en: The catalogue erroneously listed the painting as a nineteenth-century copy.
entries.zh: 目录错误地将这幅画列为十九世纪的复制品。

entries.en: The software can randomize the order of questions for each participant.
entries.zh: 这款软件可以为每位参与者随机排列问题的顺序。

entries.en: The changeover to the new booking system took place during the weekend.
entries.zh: 切换到新预订系统的工作在周末进行。

entries.en: He entered the four-digit code on the keypad beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 他在入口旁的数字键盘上输入了四位数密码。

entries.en: Her arthritic hands made fastening the small buttons difficult.
entries.zh: 她的双手患有关节炎，扣那些小纽扣很困难。

entries.en: The seaside cafe served a thick chowder with fresh bread.
entries.zh: 海边的咖啡馆供应浓稠的杂烩汤，并配上新鲜面包。

entries.en: The young actor found the sudden adulation both flattering and unsettling.
entries.zh: 突如其来的过度赞美让这位年轻演员既受宠若惊，又感到不安。

entries.en: The publisher released an omnibus containing all four detective novels.
entries.zh: 出版社推出了一本收录全部四部侦探小说的汇编本。

entries.en: The two organizations will hereafter share responsibility for maintaining the archive.
entries.zh: 此后，这两个组织将共同负责维护档案。

entries.en: The two finalists agreed to a rematch at the summer tournament.
entries.zh: 两位决赛选手同意在夏季锦标赛中再次交手。

entries.en: Small tools lay neatly arranged across the carpenter's wooden workbench.
entries.zh: 各种小工具整齐地摆在木匠的木制工作台上。

entries.en: She doggedly continued the search until she found the missing photograph.
entries.zh: 她顽强地继续寻找，直到找到那张丢失的照片。
